key_findings: Oxytocin in the ACC attenuates nociceptive and anxiety-like responses in neuropathic pain animals, also with optogenetic activation of oxytocinergic terminals.
Oxytocin selectively blocks maintenance of ACC pre-LTP (not post-LTP), enhances inhibitory transmission and excites ACC interneurons.
